name: No recording, presumed no-show
description: At the end of the day, every call that ended with no recording and no outcome is presumed a no-show: the closer's end-of-day form opens with no-show prefilled for it, and the closer confirms or corrects. Nothing is marked until they answer; their answer is what starts the no-show texts and the 👻 on the booking post (D46). For companies where every held call is recorded; turn it off for one that isn't.
